name: avunu/cloudflare-email-tools
description: Static-analysis inputs for cloudflare-email (WordPress and WP-CLI stubs, the PHPStan WordPress extension). Deliberately separate from the plugin's composer.json: that file is published to Packagist, and the "replace" of phpstan/phpstan below (the PHPStan binary comes from nixpkgs, and composition-c4 cannot fetch the dist-only phpstan/phpstan package) would otherwise leak into every site that installs the plugin.
